mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can lower seizure threshold and reduce lacosamide efficacy; lacosamide may cause dizziness/ataxia which is compounded by bumetanide's orthostatic effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes (especially potassium and sodium) regularly; assess seizure control and CNS symptoms; consider potassium-sparing agent if hypokalemia develops.
